🔬 Tabletop Pipeline Experimental Layout

⏱️ The 3 Operational Phases of the Tabletop Experiment
Phase 1: 0 – 5 min

Pre-Supply (Valve Closed)

Valve V_MAIN is closed. Zero flow across all pipes (0 LPS). Gauge pressure is zero everywhere.

Phase 2: 5 – 15 min

Water Supply Window (Active)

Valve V_MAIN opens. Water flows at 1.185 LPS. When a leak opens at minute 8, pressure drops, establishing the Pressure Sensitivity Matrix (PSM).

Phase 3: 15 – 30 min

Supply Shutoff (Valve Closed)

Valve V_MAIN closes at minute 15. Flow drops back to 0 LPS. Network pressure returns to zero.
